name: Ester Industries Limited

verdict_notes: revenue growth under 15% YoY without 30%+ profit growth

missing.reason: not in results store (not filed, not fetched, or filer is half-yearly)

annual_report.business: Ester Industries Limited manufactures polyester films, specialty polymers, and recycled PET, and is developing chemical recycling capabilities through a joint venture.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Current capacity 28,000 MT/annum; new 20,000 MT/annum facility in Hyderabad commercialized in FY26
FEED study completed; detailed engineering contract awarded to Toyo Engineering; land acquisition likely to close in next 2-3 months
Term loans from Bank of India, Bank of Baroda, HDFC Bank, OLB Bank Germany for project setup; repayments starting Sep 2023 to Jun 2023

capacity_or_capex.item: Upgradation of machinery/capex at existing Hyderabad plant
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Term loan from Yes Bank; repayable in 60 equal quarterly instalments starting June 2027

guidance_or_targets.statement: Transition from commodity-exposed enterprise to technology-led specialized materials player
guidance_or_targets.value: De-risk earnings profile through high-margin Specialty Polymers, value-added packaging films, and advanced recycling

key_risks: Cyclical commodity variations in polyester sector
Structural demand-supply mismatches in global packaging film market
Tariff setbacks in US market for VAS films
Volatile input costs and persistent supply imbalances
Revenue recognition risk due to high volume of sale transactions across distribution channels

latest_guidance.statement: Target sustainable 15% EBITDA margin for polyester films at 50-60% VAS share
Specialty Polymers targeting ~25% CAGR over next 3-5 years with FY27 as base
Elite JV commercial operations targeted last quarter of calendar year 2028
Elite JV capital outlay INR 1,200-1,400 crore for 45,000 MTPA recycled polyester chips with 40-45% EBITDA margin
